title: Atomic Functions Decomposition — DK Bond Tracker
sources: docs/SRS_DK_Bond_Tracker_v1.json (42 requirements with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria)
d5_status_rule: Danger = ANY unpaid past month (not just previous month); Completed overrides Danger when months paid >= tenure; zero-value = unpaid preserved
l1_flag: Ledger reconciliation (AF-08) compares imported figures against a baseline that is an OPEN owner decision per ADR-10: the workbook computes Total Till Return 56227.88 and Total Balance -1165738.34 while the PRD/SRS exit figures are 111638.57 and -925503.44, and the Balance definition itself is contested (workbook L = K - J maturity amount vs PRD Till Return - Total Investment). Reconciliation cannot honestly pass until the owner re-baselines; the mismatch is reported, never silently reconciled or silently passed.

atomic_functions.name: Initialize SQLite schema
atomic_functions.purpose: Create the local SQLite database file with the bonds, payment_ledger and home_plan tables and their documented columns and indexes. No per-month column ever exists — months are rows only (D3).
outputs: SQLite file with bonds, payment_ledger (UNIQUE(bond_id, month)) and home_plan tables
triggers: Application first launch with no database file
Import script starts against an empty database
postconditions: All three tables exist with documented columns
No per-month columns exist anywhere in the schema

atomic_functions.name: Open and normalize workbook
atomic_functions.purpose: Load v5.5_40L_Project_Tracker.xlsm with openpyxl in two passes (data_only=True cached values, data_only=False formulas) and normalize sheet names by trimming whitespace (the watch-list sheet is 'Bond - Watch list ' with a trailing space). The source file is opened read-only and never written.
outputs: normalized workbook handle with trimmed sheet-name lookup
source file SHA-256 and mtime recorded
triggers: Operator runs the one-time import script
preconditions: Source XLSM exists and is readable
postconditions: Workbook loaded twice (values + formulas)
Sheet lookup succeeds on normalized names (trailing space trimmed)
Source file hash and mtime recorded to prove it stays unmodified (FR-08)

atomic_functions.name: Extract bond master records
atomic_functions.purpose: Detect bond columns on the Monthly Returns sheet by header keyword with company names taken from column E (column A is Status, column B is Purchase Date), and extract all 15 bonds' master fields verbatim. Detection never uses fixed column positions.
outputs: list of bond master records (isin, company, rating, principle_tl, tenure_months, maturity_date, maturity_amount, purchase_date, broker, interest_start_month, payment_type)
triggers: Import pipeline after AF-02
postconditions: 15 bond master records extracted with header-keyword detection and names from column E
No field read by fixed column position or raw header-string coupling

atomic_functions.name: Extract payment grid rows
atomic_functions.purpose: Derive the month header grid at runtime from row-1 headers (83 headers, 2025-09..2032-07 — no hardcoded window) and extract one payment record per month cell for every bond, recomputing K = SUM(month row) and L = K - J because those columns are formulas, not stored numbers.
outputs: list of payment records (bond isin, month YYYY-MM, amount, paid flag)
per-bond recomputed K (Till Return) and L (Balance) as parse evidence
triggers: Import pipeline after AF-03
postconditions: Month extent derived at runtime: first 2025-09, last 2032-07, count 83 — no hardcoded header list
K and L recomputed from month row and maturity amount, not read as static cells
Dashboard caches treated as parse evidence only, never as truth

atomic_functions.name: Extract home plan schedule rows
atomic_functions.purpose: Extract the 84-month Home Plan schedule (month index 1..84), preserving static inputs (date, saving including irregular 39588, 10063 and 0, rate, countdown) verbatim and taking cached values for formula cells (per-year interest, remaining interest, schedule totals).
outputs: list of home_plan records (month_index, saving, rate, per_year_interest, countdown, remaining_interest)
triggers: Import pipeline after AF-02
postconditions: All 84 schedule months extracted
Irregular savings 39588, 10063 and 0 preserved verbatim in their original month positions (ERR-06)
Formula cells taken from cached values, static cells preserved verbatim

atomic_functions.name: Extract watch list analytics inputs
atomic_functions.purpose: Extract the watch-list sheet's per-bond analytics input fields (face value, principle, T.L.P, discount inputs) needed to reproduce the Excel analytics formulas in Phase 3.
outputs: list of watch-list input records (isin, face value, principle, T.L.P, discount inputs)
triggers: Import pipeline after AF-02
preconditions: Watch-list sheet found via trimmed name lookup
postconditions: Watch-list inputs extracted for every bond row on the sheet
Sheet located through normalized (trimmed) name, matching 'Bond - Watch list '

atomic_functions.name: Validate extracted import data
atomic_functions.purpose: Run pre-commit validation over the full extracted set: duplicate-ISIN detection across the entire bond set (not a partial row range), and completeness checks that every expected master field and schedule row is present. Any failure aborts the import with an explicit named error.
outputs: validation result (pass or list of explicit failures)
triggers: Import pipeline after all extract steps complete
postconditions: Duplicate ISIN anywhere in the full bond set is flagged (ERR-04)
Any missing field or schedule row is reported by name
On failure the import aborts — no partial silent import is presented as success (ERR-05)

atomic_functions.name: Reconcile imported figures against baseline
atomic_functions.purpose: Compute bond count, Total Investment, Total Till Return and Total Balance from the extracted data and compare them against the reconciliation baseline, printing computed and baseline figures side by side. The L1 figures are an OPEN owner decision per ADR-10 — this function reports the mismatch and cannot pass until the owner re-baselines.
inputs: extracted payment records with recomputed K/L (AF-04)
baseline figures (PRD exit figures and/or workbook-derived figures pending owner re-baseline)
outputs: reconciliation report (computed vs baseline with deltas)
explicit L1 flag when figures do not match the open baseline
triggers: Import pipeline after extraction and validation
preconditions: Bond master and payment records extracted (AF-03, AF-04)
postconditions: Report lists bond count (15), Total Investment (1037142.01), Total Till Return and Total Balance computed side by side with the baseline

L1 is flagged, not resolved: the workbook computes Total Till Return 56227.88 and Total Balance -1165738.34 while the PRD/SRS exit figures are 111638.57 and -925503.44; the Balance definition (workbook L = K - J maturity amount vs PRD Till Return - Total Investment) is also contested — both sub-decisions are OPEN owner decisions under ADR-10
Reconciliation cannot honestly pass until the owner re-baselines; the mismatch is never silently reconciled and no acceptance test may be green-washed against the stale PRD numbers

atomic_functions.name: Commit import records to database
atomic_functions.purpose: Write the validated and reconciled records into SQLite in one explicit transaction: bonds (15 rows, master fields verbatim), payment_ledger (one row per month cell) and home_plan (84 rows verbatim). Aborts with a named error on any write failure — never a partial silent import.
outputs: populated bonds, payment_ledger and home_plan tables
import success report with imported counts and reconciliation summary
triggers: Import pipeline after validation (AF-07) and reconciliation (AF-08)
preconditions: Reconciliation report produced (AF-08) — L1 flag travels with the report
postconditions: bonds holds exactly 15 rows matching the workbook field by field
payment_ledger holds one row per imported month cell; home_plan holds all 84 schedule rows
Source XLSM hash and mtime unchanged (read-only backup)
L1 reconciliation flag included in the import report — not silently dropped

atomic_functions.name: Insert payment ledger row
atomic_functions.purpose: Store one recorded payment as exactly one payment_ledger row (bond_id, month YYYY-MM, amount, paid flag). No schema change and no month column is ever added.
triggers: User submits a payment in the month grid or payment form
preconditions: Month is parseable and amount is numeric
postconditions: payment_ledger gains exactly one row with the given bond ref, month, amount and paid flag
No column was added to any table

atomic_functions.name: Void or correct a payment row
atomic_functions.purpose: Update or remove an existing payment_ledger row when the user corrects an amount, flips the paid flag, or voids the payment (including setting amount to 0, which counts as unpaid everywhere under D5).
inputs: new amount and/or paid flag, or void instruction
triggers: User edits an existing payment cell in the month grid
preconditions: Target ledger row exists for the bond and month
postconditions: The ledger row reflects the correction or is removed
A zero-amount result is stored as a row with amount 0 and counts as unpaid (ERR-02)

atomic_functions.name: Compute per-bond month totals
atomic_functions.purpose: Compute per-bond aggregates from ledger rows: months paid count and Till Return (sum of paid ledger rows). Result is query-only and never stored.
outputs: Till Return (sum of paid ledger rows)
triggers: Dashboard query, month grid render or bond detail view needs per-bond totals
preconditions: Bond has ledger rows or an empty result is acceptable
postconditions: Till Return equals the sum of paid ledger rows
No persisted Till Return column is read or written

atomic_functions.name: Compute portfolio totals
atomic_functions.purpose: Compute portfolio-level aggregates as queries: Total Investment (sum of principal TL amount (workbook column G)), Total Till Return (sum of paid ledger rows across the portfolio) and Balance (Till Return minus Maturity Amount). Never stored.
triggers: Dashboard summary-amounts query or export needs portfolio totals
preconditions: Bonds and ledger populated (import or manual entry)
postconditions: Till Return equals the sum of paid ledger rows
Balance equals Till Return minus Maturity Amount (workbook L = K - J)
Totals are returned by queries only — no stored total columns exist (DATA-05)

atomic_functions.name: Compute single-bond status
atomic_functions.purpose: Compute one bond's Danger/On-going/Completed status from its ledger rows under decision D5, scanning every past month in the due window (start month .. min(current month, start+tenure-1)) with no scan-window limit. Status is never stored.
triggers: Any view needs a bond's status (grid, dashboard, overview, reinvestment)
postconditions: D5 applied exactly: "Danger = ANY unpaid past month (not just previous month); Completed overrides Danger when months paid >= tenure; zero-value = unpaid preserved"
A bond with an old miss but a paid previous month reads Danger
A bond with months paid >= tenure reads Completed even with historical gaps
A zero-amount row counts as unpaid
No scan-window limit: a bond starting Feb-2031 or later is evaluated by the same rules (FR-19)
Status is computed, never persisted

atomic_functions.name: Recompute status after payment change
atomic_functions.purpose: After a payment insert, correction or void, recompute the affected bond's status immediately under D5 so the next view shows the new status with no open/save event.
triggers: Payment inserted (AF-10) or corrected/voided (AF-11)
postconditions: Status recomputed under D5: "Danger = ANY unpaid past month (not just previous month); Completed overrides Danger when months paid >= tenure; zero-value = unpaid preserved"
Removing or zeroing an older past-month payment flips an On-going bond to Danger on the next read
A Completed bond stays Completed because Completed overrides Danger
No file open/save/restart event is required for the new status to be visible

atomic_functions.name: Recompute all bond statuses
atomic_functions.purpose: Recompute status for every bond in the portfolio under D5 — used at startup, after bulk import, and for maintenance sweeps. Result is used on view, never written to a status column.
outputs: status per bond for the full portfolio
triggers: Application startup
Import commit completes (AF-09)
Bulk ledger maintenance
postconditions: Every bond receives a D5 status: "Danger = ANY unpaid past month (not just previous month); Completed overrides Danger when months paid >= tenure; zero-value = unpaid preserved"
Bonds beyond any legacy window are evaluated, never silently skipped (ERR-01)
No status snapshot table is written

atomic_functions.name: Query portfolio summary counts
atomic_functions.purpose: Return portfolio summary counts — Total bonds, Danger, On-going and Completed — as a live query over current D5 statuses.
triggers: Dashboard view or status overview needs summary counts
postconditions: Counts equal the query result over current data
No stored snapshot table is read

atomic_functions.name: Query portfolio summary amounts
atomic_functions.purpose: Return the dashboard amount figures — Total Investment, Total Till Return and Total Balance — as live queries over current ledger and bond data.
triggers: Dashboard view or export needs summary amounts
postconditions: Till Return equals the sum of paid ledger rows; Balance equals Till Return minus Maturity Amount
Every figure equals the query result over current data — no cached snapshot

atomic_functions.name: Query this-month returns
atomic_functions.purpose: Sum the current calendar month's payments across the portfolio as a live query. When the current month cannot be resolved, return an explicit message — never a silent 0 (ERR-03).
triggers: Dashboard view needs This Month Returns
postconditions: Total equals the sum of ledger rows for the dynamic current month
If the current month cannot be resolved, an explicit message is produced instead of a silent 0

atomic_functions.name: Aggregate monthly history table
atomic_functions.purpose: Aggregate portfolio payment totals per month across the full derived window (the real workbook span is 83 months, 2025-09..2032-07) into the monthly history table, with future months shown as 0. No hardcoded header list and no window limit.
outputs: month/total rows for the full history range
triggers: Dashboard view renders the full monthly returns history
postconditions: History covers the entire derived window continuously
A simulated current month beyond Feb-2027 still yields continuous columns with no missing months
No hardcoded Sep-2025..Feb-2027 header sequence is used

atomic_functions.name: Produce bonds status overview
atomic_functions.purpose: Produce the bonds status overview: every bond with its D5 status, ordered Danger, then On-going, then Completed, each row carrying its display color (red/orange/green).
outputs: ordered bond rows with status and color key (red=Danger, orange=On-going, green=Completed)
triggers: Dashboard view renders the bonds status overview
postconditions: Rows ordered Danger -> On-going -> Completed
Status colors red/orange/green applied per D5 status value
All bonds listed, including Feb-2031+ starters — none silently skipped (ERR-01)

atomic_functions.name: Serve dashboard page from live queries
atomic_functions.purpose: Handle the dashboard route by executing all dashboard queries (summary counts, summary amounts, this-month returns, monthly history, status overview) on every request and rendering the result server-side. No open/save event exists; freshness is a property of querying on every request.
outputs: server-rendered dashboard HTML with live figures
triggers: Browser requests the dashboard URL or reloads the page
postconditions: Every figure on the page equals its query result over current data
Reloading after any payment edit shows updated figures with no open/save/restart
Unresolvable current month renders the explicit message, not a silent 0

atomic_functions.name: Launch local Flask application
atomic_functions.purpose: Start the Flask server bound to 127.0.0.1 from the single documented launch command and open/point the browser at the dashboard. Server-rendered HTML, no build step, no npm, no bundler.
triggers: User runs the documented launch command on a clean machine
preconditions: Python and the project folder present
postconditions: Flask serves the UI as plain server-rendered HTML with no build step
Working dashboard reachable within 60 seconds on a clean machine (NFR-4)
Server binds localhost only — no outbound network

atomic_functions.name: Render month grid
atomic_functions.purpose: Derive the month window at render time from bond start month + tenure (no hardcoded Sep-2025..Feb-2027 headers, no Jan-2031 limit), build the Excel-like months-across grid from ledger rows, and apply cell colors: green paid, light red due, status cells red/orange/green.
outputs: server-rendered month-grid HTML with dynamic columns and color classes
triggers: User opens the month grid view
postconditions: Paid month cells render green and unpaid due cells light red
Status cells render red/orange/green for Danger/On-going/Completed
Columns generated continuously through the current month with no missing months and no schema change
A bond starting Feb-2031 or later renders all its month rows with correct coloring (ERR-01)

atomic_functions.name: Handle payment cell edit
atomic_functions.purpose: Handle the payment POST from the month grid — the Worksheet_Change equivalent: validate input, insert or correct the ledger row, trigger the D5 status recompute, and redirect back to the grid so the cell and status cell render updated.
inputs: POST payment form (bond id, month, amount)
triggers: User enters or edits a payment cell in the month grid
preconditions: Bond exists; month parseable; amount numeric (validators)
postconditions: Payment persisted as exactly one ledger row
Bond status recomputed immediately under D5 with no open/save event
Next grid render shows the updated cell color and status color

atomic_functions.name: Export current view as UTF-8 CSV
atomic_functions.purpose: Serialize the rows and headers of any currently displayed dataset (dashboard table, month grid, Home Plan, watch list, bond detail) to a UTF-8 CSV download. Export reads the same rows the screen displays — never a different source.
inputs: rows and headers currently displayed for that view
triggers: User clicks export on a displayed dataset
preconditions: View rendered and its rows available
postconditions: CSV rows and headers match the displayed data
Rupee amounts parse as plain values with no encoding errors in any spreadsheet app
No xlsx export is produced — CSV replaces xlsx entirely (D4)

atomic_functions.name: Export full payment ledger as UTF-8 CSV
atomic_functions.purpose: Export the complete payment ledger (every bond, every month row: bond ref, month, amount, paid flag) to a UTF-8 CSV file for sharing or offline analysis.
outputs: UTF-8 CSV file of the full ledger
triggers: User requests a full-ledger export
postconditions: CSV contains one row per ledger entry with correct columns and no encoding errors
Export contents match a direct ledger query

atomic_functions.name: Check duplicate ISIN across full bond set
atomic_functions.purpose: Detect duplicate ISIN values across the entire bond set — not a partial row range — and flag every occurrence (e.g. the same ISIN on row 2 and row 40 of 40 bonds both flagged).
inputs: full set of bond ISIN values (extracted set or bonds table)
outputs: list of duplicated ISIN values with all their occurrences
triggers: Import validation (AF-07)
Bond creation or edit via web forms
Periodic data check
postconditions: A duplicate anywhere in the full set is flagged with every occurrence (ERR-04)
No partial row-range scan is used

atomic_functions.name: Enforce stable schema-key access
atomic_functions.purpose: Guard that all data reads and writes use stable schema keys and never couple logic to workbook header text or fixed column positions; display-label renames (e.g. Staus -> Status) must change no query, status rule or import behavior.
inputs: code paths reading or writing bond/ledger fields
outputs: list of any header-string or position couplings found
triggers: Code review gate
Import column mapping (AF-03) applies keyword detection with schema keys
UI label change
preconditions: Schema keys defined for bonds and payment_ledger
postconditions: Field access uses stable schema keys only
Renaming a display label changes no query, status rule or import logic
No logic keys on workbook header strings or hard-coded column numbers

atomic_functions.name: Surface operation errors visibly
atomic_functions.purpose: Wrapper around operations that converts any failure into an explicit user-visible message naming the failed operation — replacing the VBA 'On Error Resume Next' pattern of silent swallowing. No default zeros, empty success or ignore-and-continue fallback may be presented as a completed operation.
outputs: visible error message or error page naming the failed operation
triggers: Any operation fails: unreadable XLSM, missing sheet, reconciliation break, query error, export error, unresolvable current month
preconditions: Error handlers installed on routes; import pipeline uses explicit aborts
postconditions: Every induced failure produces a visible message naming the failed operation
No silent fallback (default zeros, empty success) is presented as a completed operation
Import failures abort the whole run — never a partial import reported as success (ERR-05)

atomic_functions.name: Render Home Plan schedule view
atomic_functions.purpose: Render the imported 84-month Home Plan savings schedule (month index 1..84 with saving, rate, per-year interest, countdown, remaining interest and totals) exactly from stored values, including the irregular savings 39588, 10063 and 0 in their original month positions.
outputs: server-rendered Home Plan HTML listing all 84 months plus totals
triggers: User opens the Home Plan view
preconditions: Home Plan rows committed to the database (AF-09)
postconditions: All 84 months listed with irregular savings 39588, 10063 and 0 in original positions
Rate, per-year interest, countdown, remaining interest and totals match the stored Excel values row by row (ERR-06 verbatim preservation)

atomic_functions.name: Compute watch list analytics
atomic_functions.purpose: Reproduce the Excel watch-list analytics formulas over imported inputs (DATA-04): discount, 10% TDS, per-month, qty TL and 12-month totals, computed on view and never stored.
outputs: analytics rows: face value, principle, T.L.P, discount, per-month, 10% TDS, 12-month, qty, TL principle
triggers: User views the watch list (Phase 3)
postconditions: Computed discount, 10% TDS, per-month, qty TL and 12-month totals match the Excel watch-list outputs for the same bond
Analytics are computed on view — never persisted as columns

atomic_functions.name: Compute reinvestment free-up
atomic_functions.purpose: Report the principal freed by Completed bonds as available to reinvest, and apply duplicate-deduction rules only to On-going and Danger bonds — a Completed bond's principal is never deducted twice.
triggers: Dashboard reinvestment free-up panel is viewed
postconditions: A Completed bond's full principal is reported as available to reinvest
Deductions apply only to On-going and Danger bonds; Completed bonds are excluded from deduction

atomic_functions.name: Compute bond discount amount
atomic_functions.purpose: Record and display the discount amount per bond on the bond detail view (Phase 4), using the bonds.discount column and live query display.
outputs: discount amount displayed on bond detail
triggers: User opens bond detail for a discounted bond (Phase 4)
preconditions: bonds table carries the discount column
postconditions: The discount amount for the bond is displayed alongside its other master fields
Discount value comes from the bond record, not a stored derived cache

atomic_functions.name: Compute TDS deduction on payout
atomic_functions.purpose: Compute the TDS deduction on a due payout (10% rate per the workbook watch-list formula) and present the TDS amount alongside the net payout (Phase 4).
triggers: A payout is due or a payout line is rendered (Phase 4)
postconditions: For a due payout of 10000 at 10% TDS, TDS of 1000 is shown with a net amount of 9000
TDS is computed per payout, not stored

atomic_functions.name: Generate payout due dates by cycle
atomic_functions.purpose: Generate due dates on the bond's payment-type cycle — monthly, quarterly or yearly — instead of assuming every month (Phase 4). The ledger stays month-row based; cycle determines which months are due.
outputs: list of due months across the tenure
triggers: Due schedule is computed for a bond with quarterly or yearly payment type (Phase 4)
preconditions: Bond metadata available (start month, tenure, payment type)
postconditions: A quarterly bond starting Sep-2025 yields due dates Sep-2025, Dec-2025, Mar-2026 and so on through the tenure — not every month
A yearly bond yields exactly one due date per year of the tenure
A monthly bond yields every month of the tenure

atomic_functions.name: Compute dashboard P&L and ongoing TL
atomic_functions.purpose: Compute and display the dashboard P&L figure and the ongoing bond total (TL) value from current ledger and bond data (Phase 4), as live queries matching the dashboard freshness model.
triggers: Dashboard is viewed with Phase 4 features enabled
postconditions: Both P&L and ongoing TL are displayed
Both figures match the query results over current ledger and bond data
